features.name: cross__btc_eth_spread
features.description: BTC spot price minus ETH spot price capturing relative value pressure.

features.name: cross__perp_spot_basis
features.description: BTC perpetual price minus BTC spot price; leverage premium or discount.

features.name: cross__funding_rate
features.description: Current perpetual funding rate with forward-fill only and no smoothing.

features.name: cross__btc_dxy_corr_proxy
features.description: Rolling past-only correlation proxy between BTC returns and USD index returns.

features.name: cross__funding_8h_rolling_avg
features.description: Backward-looking 8-hour rolling mean of the funding rate.

features.name: cross__basis_change
features.description: First difference of the perpetual-spot basis measuring leverage pressure acceleration.

features.name: cross__risk_on_off_flag
features.description: Boolean proxy based on funding sign, basis sign, and correlation direction using fixed rules.

features.name: cross__perp_basis_velocity
features.description: Time-normalized rate of change of the perpetual-spot basis using backward deltas only.

features.name: cross__correlation_instability
features.description: Absolute change in rolling BTC-USD index correlation indicating macro coupling shifts.
